notes: 2026-08-31 bounded raw-carrier probe: tested two new structural models for the reference's adjacent signed and unsigned loads from 0x02004c00. First, an explicit u16 current_raw load retained for the later store alongside the s16 current used for division compiled byte-identically to the 100-byte baseline: GCC 2.96 commoned the two typed reads and still stored the signed-load carrier, leaving 21 differing halfwords / 22 wrong instructions. Second, making only the raw u16 read volatile did preserve a distinct ldrh, but scheduled it before the ldrsh, inserted an lsl/asr sign-extension pair, grew the owner to 104 bytes, and regressed to 47 differing halfwords / 54 wrong instructions. Both were reverted. Transferable negative fact: ordinary signed/unsigned alias loads at one address are commoned on this route, while volatile separation produces the wrong load order and extra sign extension; do not retry either raw-carrier axis without evidence for a different aggregate or access boundary.

2026-08-31 exact-closure verdict: the retained reference requires adjacent ldrsh and ldrh accesses to 0x02004c00, preserving the raw halfword in r4 across both signed divide-by-eight sequences and storing that raw carrier only on group change. The legitimate baseline reproduces all 100 bytes of extent and equal branch topology but GCC common-loads the signed/raw expressions, removes the ldrh, and consequently never saves r6. Distinct signed/unsigned one-field aggregate views are byte-identical to baseline. Making both views volatile grows to 108 bytes and adds two lsl/asr sign-extension pairs; declaring a volatile signed absolute cell plus a nonvolatile raw view grows to 104 bytes and orders ldrh before ldrsh. Finite shipped toggles -fno-cse-follow-jumps, -fno-gcse, -fno-expensive-optimizations, -fno-force-mem, -fno-force-addr, -fno-schedule-insns, and -fno-regmove do not improve the ordinary duplicate-load model; -fno-rerun-cse-after-loop and peephole/strength-reduction probes regress the volatile model. Exactness therefore needs authentic source evidence for an access boundary that preserves two differently typed reads in this exact order. Compiler barriers, artificial calls, and forced volatile traffic would manufacture that boundary and are rejected. Retain the DH21 ordinary-C draft.
